_comment: Stream processor Lambda config. Set CONFIG_PATH as an env var here — the SQS/S3 trigger carries data, not config.
_zones: Medallion defaults: bronze/events/ and quarantine/events/. Set BRONZE_EVENTS_PREFIX / QUARANTINE_EVENTS_PREFIX to move them.
_drop_rejects: Set QUARANTINE_EVENTS_PREFIX to "" to drop failing records instead of archiving them.
